title: Gloomy Rise Textures
description: Some textures for Gloomy Rise Modpack!
body:
# Textures for some GUI

Gloomy Rise Textures is a resource pack created by the BMProjects team. Its purpose is to add in our Gloomy Rise modpack some new textures that changed vanilla GUI. This need for more immersion in atmosphere of project!

## Mods Compability:
Cosmetic Armor Reworked
Curios
Quark
 
## FAQ:
Q: Can I use this resource pack in my modpack?

A: Yes, of course!
